newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, loses early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, loses early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost its early edge and ended weaker at 42.5480/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading against Sunday's 42.5460/5490, dealers said.
Dealers said the local unit was quoted at 42.5460/5495 in early trade but eased on higher dollar demand.
"There was heavy demand for the U.S. currency. Some net sellers were buyers today," said one dealer.
Call money rates finished higher at 4.5 percent to 6.0 percent against the previous close of 4.0-5.0 percent, dealers said.
